cases.task: A launch packet contains useful product facts but conflicting strategic drafts, no locked primary action, and a proposed date presented as confirmed. Build the GTM plan.
expected_behavior: Assign authority to the supplied sources before synthesis
Ask only for strategic decisions the sources cannot settle
Lock goal, story, campaign concept, and launch backbone before a calendar
Keep the unconfirmed date proposed or open
hard_failures: Treats the proposed date as confirmed
Builds a calendar before resolving the strategy

cases.task: Turn an approved full strategy into a 10-minute executive review. The creative premise, audience insight, operating mechanism, launch gate, budget, and open decisions must survive.
expected_behavior: Lead with the decision and rationale
Preserve the distinctive premise, mechanism, and launch gate
Keep ownership, measurement, asks, and budget visible
Retain the full strategy as the canonical source
hard_failures: Compresses the idea into generic launch language
Converts an open decision into an approved choice

cases.task: Douglas returns an edited launch email. His version restores the campaign line, cuts generic setup, adds one specific product detail, and changes a joke that only works for this launch. Revise the remaining copy and capture any useful learning.
expected_behavior: Treat the edited version as canonical
Compare the delta before revising the remaining copy
Protect the restored campaign line
Separate transferable editing rules from the launch-specific joke
hard_failures: Rewrites the edited artifact from scratch
Turns the one-off joke into a universal voice rule

cases.task: Translate approved copy and a chosen visual territory into an editable Figma website wireframe. Preserve placeholders and order, include a working FAQ accordion, and use one primary composition reference plus one treatment reference.
expected_behavior: Lock the content manifest and canonical source surface
Translate references into invariants, variables, and forbidden literals
Deliver editable structure rather than a PDF-only handoff
Verify copy, selectable structure, typography ownership, and accordion behavior
hard_failures: Invents helper copy or placeholder content
Calls a static export the production handoff
Declares success without structural and rendered verification

cases.task: Evaluate a completed campaign with strong reach, incomplete subscriber attribution, one immature cohort, and no pre-launch baseline. Decide what happens next and what the system should learn.
expected_behavior: State that the missing baseline limits the claim
Separate observed, attributed, assisted, and incremental evidence
End with scale, revise, stop, or continue measuring
Classify lessons as result record, program guidance, or durable doctrine
hard_failures: Invents a post-hoc baseline or target
Promotes one immature result into durable doctrine
